qualification.details: Qualifications and experience follow the Four-Tier Flexible Faculty Structure as per Ministry of Education guidelines (F.No.27-11/2011 TS.1 dated 23 April 2014). All degrees acquired by the applicant must be from an Institute / University recognized by the UGC/AICTE/AIU/GOI. All applicants shall have a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and First Class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor's Degree onwards). In case First Class is not mentioned in the preceding degrees by the University/Institution, candidates should have passed and secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate. Conversion from CGPA to percentage or vice versa given by an individual Institute/University will not be considered or allowed for determination of eligibility. | Other Essential Requirements: None. Additional Desirable Requirements: One publication in an SCI Journal. | Other Essential Requirements: One paper accepted for publication in an SCI Journal. Additional Desirable Requirements: Two papers in SCI Journals or one patent; may be based on Ph.D. work. | Other Essential Requirements: 04 papers in SCI journals after Ph.D.; one Ph.D. guided as sole or principal supervisor plus one continuing; two projects ongoing or one ongoing plus one completed; two experiments or computational projects added to teaching laboratories where appropriate; academic outreach activity equivalent to two self-financed short-term courses. Additional Desirable Requirements: 01 or more patents; supervising two or more students for Ph.D.; strong liaison with industry; offering courses through application of ICT. | For Engineering: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates possessing a Ph.D. directly after B.Tech./B.E. from reputed institutions are also considered provided they have First Class at the Bachelor's level. For Mathematics: First Class at both UG and PG levels (60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA) with Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Countable Experience: Only experience rendered on a regular basis in applicable pay scales as per UGC, AICTE, Government of India, or PSUs is counted. Experience rendered on part-time, ad-hoc, daily wage, visiting, guest faculty, fixed remuneration, contractual, or temporary basis will not be considered. Equal Treatment: There shall be no distinction between external and internal candidates with regard to the requirements of qualification and experience. Age Limit: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except in the case of faculty with an exceptionally brilliant research career and with an ongoing or approved externally funded research project. The crucial date for determining eligibility and preferred age limit is 21 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official Samarth recruitment portal at https://iiitsonepatrec.samarth.edu.in/.
Complete registration and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and experience details.
Upload self-attested copies of certificates, testimonials, category certificate (if applicable), and recent photograph.
Pay the non-refundable application processing fee online through the payment gateway.
Submit the online application form on or before 21 November 2026 (up to 11:59 PM) and note down the unique application/form reference number.
Download and print the filled-in application form PDF from the portal.

Prepare a properly spiral-bound hard copy, sequentially paginating every page, and attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents, experience letters, pay slips, and the Annexure-I NOC/VCC if serving in Government/PSU.
Place the spiral-bound application into a preferably A4/Legal/A3-sized envelope and superscribe the cover with: APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ____________________.

Send the hard copy by speed post, registered post, or courier to: Office of the Indian Institute of Information Technology Sonepat, IIT Delhi Sonepat Campus, I-Tech Technopark Plot No 4 Rajiv Gandhi Education City, Rai, Sonipat -131029, Haryana, India so that it reaches on or before 1 December 2026 till 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete, unbound, or loosely compiled hard copy applications, as well as applications received after 1 December 2026 (5:00 PM), will be summarily rejected without considering postal delays. Serving employees must submit applications through proper channel or upload an undertaking; in case a candidate does not produce NOC and Vigilance Clearance Certificate at the time of the Written Test and/or Presentation/Demo/Interview, he/she will not be permitted to appear under any circumstances. Candidates must bring original documents and a valid photo ID proof to the written test, presentation, or interview; failure to present them will lead to debarment. Any person who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or who having a spouse alive has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, is not eligible for appointment. Selected candidates must be found medically fit through a medical examination conducted by the designated medical authority. The Institute reserves the right to modify, defer, or cancel full or part of the recruitment at any stage without assigning any reason, and reserves the right not to fill any post(s). In case of any inadvertent error detected at any stage even after issuing an appointment letter, the institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw, or cancel any communication made to candidates. No correspondence will be entertained regarding postal delays, conduct and result of interview, or reasons for not being called; canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Any subsequent corrigendum, changes, or updates will be published only on the institute website (www.iiitsonepat.ac.in). Only selected candidates will be informed through email. All communications and queries related to the recruitment process must be directed exclusively to [email protected], and legal disputes fall under the jurisdiction of Sonepat Court.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Sonepat Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sonepat is an Institute of National Importance established in 2014 under the provisions of the Indian Institute of Information Technology PPP- Act, 2017. The institute has its permanent campus at Kilohrad, Sonepat, and operates from its office at IIT Delhi Sonepat Campus, I-Tech Technopark Plot No 4 Rajiv Gandhi Education City, Rai, Sonipat, Haryana. The institute is dedicated to imparting high-quality technical education and cultivating a rigorous culture of innovation and research in Information Technology and its allied disciplines.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies for the post of Assistant Professor are advertised across Pay Levels 10, 11, and 12 without a predetermined number earmarked for any specific Pay Level. Candidates fulfilling the prescribed criteria may submit separate applications for each Pay Level. The institute also follows horizontal reservation in case of PwD candidates. Computer Science and Engineering / IT / CSE (DSA) / CSE (AI): Full Stack Development, Enterprise Java, Blockchain, High-Performance Computing, Industrial Internet of Things, Machine Learning, Advanced Data Structure and Algorithm, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Data Analytics, Quantum Computing, Web Technologies, Generative AI. Electronics and Communication Engineering: VLSI, IoT, Embedded System, Quantum Computing, Semiconductor Devices, Visible Light Communication, 5G/6G & Wireless, RF Systems. Mathematics: Mathematics for Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Scientific Computing, Optimization Techniques, Computational Complexity, Numerical Linear Algebra. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Besides the basic pay applicable to the post, regular faculty members receive admissible allowances including Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Transport Allowance (TA) as per institute norms. All recruitments and pay-fixations are subject to the approval of the Board of Governors (BoG) of IIIT Sonepat based on the recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees. Higher starting pay may be offered to deserving candidates on the recommendation of the Selection Committee upon approval of the BoG.

faq.question: Q1. How many faculty vacancies are released under IIIT Sonepat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 7 tentative faculty vacancies are advertised, comprising 1 Associate Professor post and 6 Assistant Professor positions across Pay Levels 10, 11, and 12.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online and send the hard copy?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application on the Samarth portal is 21 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM, and the spiral-bound hard copy must reach the institute by 1 December 2026 till 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for faculty posts at IIIT Sonepat?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline with First Class (minimum 60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA) in all preceding degrees starting from the Bachelor's degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIIT Sonepat Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except in the case of faculty with an exceptionally brilliant research career and with an ongoing or approved externally funded research project.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for Assistant Professor and Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: Associate Professors are placed in Pay Level 13A2 (AGP Rs 9500/-), Assistant Professor Grade I in Pay Level 12 (AGP Rs 8000/-), and Assistant Professor Grade II in Pay Level 10 (AGP Rs 6000/-) or Pay Level 11 (AGP Rs 7000/-), plus admissible allowances like DA, HRA, and TA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IIIT Sonepat faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The online processing fee is Rs. 2,000/- for General, OBC, and EWS candidates, and Rs. 1,000/- for SC and ST candidates, while Women and PwBD candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. Can a candidate apply for more than one Pay Level or post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria for multiple Pay Levels or posts may apply, but they must submit separate applications along with the requisite fee for each post or Pay Level.

faq.question: Q8. Who is exempt from paying the application processing fee?
faq.answer: All Women candidates and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) candidates, including those applying from abroad, are fully exempt from paying the application processing fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the postal address for sending the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: The spiral-bound hard copy must be sent to: Office of the Indian Institute of Information Technology Sonepat, IIT Delhi Sonepat Campus, I-Tech Technopark Plot No 4 Rajiv Gandhi Education City, Rai, Sonipat -131029, Haryana, India.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection procedure for faculty recruitment at IIIT Sonepat?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening and shortlisting of applications based on academic and research credentials, followed by a Written Test and/or Presentation/Demo and a personal interview before the Selection Committee.
